# Vishal Boat Service

> Trusted speed boat and yacht charter operator at Gateway of India, Mumbai. Shared speed boat seats, private charters, harbour cruises, Alibaug (Mandwa) transfers and Elephanta Caves tours. Bookings via phone or WhatsApp: +91 87791 63152. Boarding from Jetty No. 5, Gateway of India.

## Services

- [Shared Mumbai Harbour Cruise](https://www.vishalboat.com/shared-mumbai-harbour-cruise): 30-minute shared speed boat harbour cruise from ₹600 per person. Daily departures 4:00 PM – 8:00 PM, every 30 minutes.
- [Speed Boat Shared Ride to Alibaug (Mandwa)](https://www.vishalboat.com/speed-boat-shared-ride-alibaug-mandwa): Shared speed boat transfer from ₹1,200 per person (one way). Approximately 20–23 minutes.
- [Shared Speed Boat Tour to Elephanta Caves](https://www.vishalboat.com/shared-speed-boat-tour-elephanta-caves): Guided shared speed boat tour to the UNESCO-listed Elephanta Caves with an English-speaking guide.
- [Charter Mumbai Harbour Cruise](https://www.vishalboat.com/charter-mumbai-harbour-cruise): Private speed boat harbour cruise from ₹6,000 per boat. 30-minute or 1-hour rides, flexible timings.
- [Speed Boat Charter Ride to Alibaug (Mandwa)](https://www.vishalboat.com/speed-boat-charter-ride-alibaug-mandwa): Private speed boat charter from ₹7,000 per boat.
- [Private Speed Boat for Elephanta Caves VVIP Tour](https://www.vishalboat.com/private-speed-boat-elephanta-caves-vvip-tour): Private VVIP speed boat tour from ₹20,000 per boat.
- [Private Yacht for Elephanta Caves VVIP Tour](https://www.vishalboat.com/private-yacht-elephanta-caves-vvip-tour): Luxury yacht VVIP tour to Elephanta Caves.

## Facts

- Operator: Vishal Boat Service, Jetty No. 5, Gateway of India, Mumbai
- Phone/WhatsApp: +91 87791 63152
- Speed boat services usually pause May–September due to monsoon.
- Life jackets are provided for all passengers.
